2607.21978.title: MoE$^2$-LoRA: When MoE Models Meet MoE-style Low-Rank Adaptation
2607.21978.paper_summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have been widely adopted in large language models, yet parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) for MoE models remains underexplored. Existing PEFT methods for MoE either ignore router priors with uniform adapters, reducing efficiency and risking forgetting, or rely on static expert selection, limiting per-token capacity and cross-expert feature learning. In this paper, we make the first attempt to fine-tune MoE models with MoE-style low-rank adaptation: our method, entitled MoE$^2$-LoRA, deeply couples the pretrained expert specialization with task-specific adaptivity via a dual-channel Routing-Conditioned Projection (RCP) module, which reuses base router activations to inform LoRA routing. We further introduce a single global LoRA expert pool shared across all layers, enabling model-wide adaptation with emergent layer-wise affinities and balanced expert utilization. MoE$^2$-LoRA simultaneously benefits from the advantages of prior reuse, dynamic adapter routing, and model-wide knowledge sharing. Evaluated on multiple MoE backbones with varying scales and expert granularities, MoE$^2$-LoRA consistently achieves state-of-the-art downstream accuracy while retaining stronger general capabilities.
2607.21978.paper_summary_zh: 混合專家（MoE）架構已廣泛應用於大型語言模型，但針對 MoE 模型的參數高效微調（PEFT）仍然未被充分探索。現有的 MoE PEFT 方法要麼以均勻適配器忽略路由器先驗，降低效率並冒著遺忘的風險，要麼依賴靜態專家選擇，限制每個標記的容量和跨專家特徵學習。在本文中，我們首次嘗試使用 MoE 風格的低秩適應來微調 MoE 模型：我們的方法名為 MoE$^2$-LoRA，通過雙通道路由條件投影（RCP）模塊，深度耦合預訓練專家的專業化與任務特定的適應性，該模塊重用基礎路由器的激活來通知 LoRA 路由。我們進一步引入一個在所有層之間共享的單一全局 LoRA 專家池，使模型能夠在層級之間適應，並實現新興的層級親和性和均衡的專家利用。MoE$^2$-LoRA 同時受益於先前重用、動態適配器路由和模型範圍的知識共享的優勢。在多個具有不同規模和專家粒度的 MoE 主幹上進行評估時，MoE$^2$-LoRA 始終實現了最先進的下游準確性，同時保留了更強的通用能力。
